text.en: Dino is row 103 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Detection Segmentation area.
text.zh: Dino 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 103 行，所属领域为“检测与分割”。

text.en: The annual table associates Dino with “Dino: Detr with improved denoising anchor boxes for end-to-end object detection”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Dino 与论文《Dino: Detr with improved denoising anchor boxes for end-to-end object detection》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Hao Zhang, Feng Li, Shilong Liu, Lei Zhang”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Hao Zhang（官方页拼写）、Feng Li（官方页拼写）、Shilong Liu（官方页拼写）、Lei Zhang（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Hao Zhang, Feng Li, Shilong Liu, Lei Zhang”。
